47219:         } else if (!missionPage && wrapper) {
47220:             removeMissionFinderPanelForClosedMission(
47221:                 'coalesced mission DOM change'
47222:             );
47223:         }

47242:             }

46818:     function mutationNodeMatches(node, selector) {
46819:         if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return false;
46820: 
46821:         try {
46822:             return (
46823:                 node.matches?.(selector) ||
46824:                 !!node.querySelector?.(selector)
46825:             );
46826:         } catch (_error) {
46827:             return false;
46828:         }
46829:     }

46833: 
46834:         try {
46835:             return !!target.closest?.(selector);
46836:         } catch (_error) {
46837:             return false;
46838:         }
46839:     }

46854:     function classifyMissionFinderMutations(records) {
46855:         const flags = {
46856:             relevant: false,
46857:             vehicleListChanged: false,
46858:             missionContextChanged: false,
46859:             patientChanged: false,
46860:             panelChanged: false,
46861:             transportChanged: false
46862:         };
46863: 
46864:         const inspectNode = node => {
46865:             if (!node || node.nodeType !== 1) return;
46866: 
46867:             if (
46868:                 node.matches?.(
46869:                     MF_MUTATION_PANEL_SELECTOR
46870:                 )
46871:             ) {
46872:                 flags.panelChanged = true;
46873:                 flags.relevant = true;
46874:                 return;
46875:             }
46876: 
46877:             if (
46878:                 node.closest?.(
46879:                     '#mission-finder-wrapper'
46880:                 )
46881:             ) {
46882:                 return;
46883:             }
46884:

46886:                 node,
46887:                 MF_MUTATION_RELEVANT_SELECTOR
46888:             )) {
46889:                 return;
46890:             }
46891: 
46892:             if (mutationNodeMatches(
46893:                 node,
46894:                 MF_MUTATION_VEHICLE_SELECTOR
46895:             )) {
46896:                 flags.vehicleListChanged = true;
46897:                 flags.relevant = true;
46898:             }
46899: 
46900:             if (mutationNodeMatches(
46901:                 node,
46902:                 MF_MUTATION_MISSION_SELECTOR
46903:             )) {
46904:                 flags.missionContextChanged = true;
46905:                 flags.relevant = true;
46906:             }
46907: 
46908:             if (mutationNodeMatches(
46909:                 node,
46910:                 MF_MUTATION_PATIENT_SELECTOR
46911:             )) {
46912:                 flags.patientChanged = true;
46913:                 flags.relevant = true;
46914:             }
46915: 
46916:             if (mutationNodeMatches(
46917:                 node,
46918:                 MF_MUTATION_TRANSPORT_SELECTOR
46919:             )) {
46920:                 flags.transportChanged = true;
46921:                 flags.relevant = true;
46922:             }
46923:         };

46925:         for (const record of records || []) {
46926: 
46927:             const target = record.target;
46928:             const changedNodes = [
46929:                 ...(record.addedNodes || []),

46933:                 changedNodes.some(node =>
46934:                     node?.nodeType === 1 &&

46936:                         MF_MUTATION_PANEL_SELECTOR

46940:                 target,
46941:                 '#mission-finder-wrapper'
46942:             );
46943: 
46944:             if (shouldIgnoreMissionFinderMutationRecord(
46945:                 targetOwned,
46946:                 hasPanelRootMutation
46947:             )) {
46948:                 continue;
46949:             }

46951:             const targetRelevant = mutationTargetWithin(
46952:                 target,
46953:                 MF_MUTATION_RELEVANT_TARGET_SELECTOR
46954:             );
46955: 
46956:             if (
46957:                 targetRelevant &&
46958:                 mutationTargetWithin(
46959:                     target,
46960:                     MF_MUTATION_VEHICLE_SELECTOR
46961:                 )
46962:             ) {
46963:                 flags.vehicleListChanged = true;
46964:                 flags.relevant = true;
46965:             }

46967:             if (

39630:     function startSilentQueueWatcher() {
39631:         if (!MF_IS_TOP_WINDOW) return;
39632:         if (mfSilentQueueWatcherTimer) return;
39633: 
39634:         mfSilentQueueWatcherTimer = setInterval(async () => {
39635:             if (isManualAutoStopActive()) return;
39636:             if (!isSilentQueueWatchActive()) return;
39637:             if (mfSilentQueueOpening) return;
39638:             if (isMainMissionOpeningPending('silent-queue-watch')) return;
39639:             if (sessionStorage.getItem(MF_QUEUE_OPENING_MISSION_FLAG) === 'true') return;
39640: 
39641:             // This catches empty/loading Vue modals as well as completed mission screens.
39642:             if (hasVisibleQueueOpenModal('silent-queue-watch')) return;
39643:             if (!canOpenMainMissionFromMainList('silent-queue-watch')) return;
39644:             if (isMissionScreenVisibleForQueueRestart()) return;
39645: 
39646:             const queueCountState =
39647:                 getQueueRestartCountState();
39648: 
39649:             if (mfDebugEnabled) {
39650:                 debugLog(

43959:     function findTransportSendButton() {
43960:         // The new MissionChief transport screen is a vehicle modal with hospital rows.
43961:         // The correct action is the first visible green "Approach" button in that table.
43962:         const exactApproachButton = findExactFirstApproachTransportButton();
43963: 
43964:         if (exactApproachButton) {
43965:             return exactApproachButton;
43966:         }
43967: 
43968:         // Fallback for older transport screens.
43969:         const candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, input[type="button"], input[type="submit"]'))
43970:             .filter(element => isElementVisible(element))
43971:             .filter(element => !isBadTransportButtonCandidate(element))
43972:             .map(element => ({
43973:                 element,
43974:                 score: scoreTransportButtonCandidate(element)
43975:             }))
43976:             .filter(item => item.score > 0)
43977:             .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
43978: 
43979:         return candidates.length ? candidates[0].element : null;
43980:     }

43998:     async function handleTransportRequestsAfterDispatch(reason) {
43999:         if (!isTransportAutomationAllowed()) return 'none';
44000: 
44001:         const firstFound = await waitForTransportScreenAfterDispatch(5000);
44002: 
44003:         if (!firstFound) {
44004:             return 'none';
44005:         }
44006: 
44007:         updateStatusBox('Transport request detected. Sending transport...');
44008: 
44009:         if (mfDebugEnabled) {
44010:             debugLog('AUTO TRANSPORT', `${reason}: transport request detected.`);
44011:         }
44012: 
44013:         let sentCount = 0;
44014:         const started = Date.now();
44015: 
44016:         while (autoModeRunning && Date.now() - started < 90000 && sentCount < 25) {
44017:             if (!isTransportScreenBlockingQueueRestart()) {
44018:                 break;
44019:             }
44020: 
44021:             const sendButton = findTransportSendButton();
44022: 
44023:             if (!sendButton) {
44024:                 if (mfDebugEnabled) {
44025:                     debugLog('AUTO TRANSPORT', `${reason}: transport screen found but no send/approach button found.`);
44026:                 }
44027: 
44028:                 updateStatusBox('Transport request detected, but no transport send button was found.');
44029:                 return sentCount > 0 ? 'partial' : 'stuck';
44030:             }
44031: 
44032:             const clicked = await clickExactApproachTransportButton(`auto-transport-${reason}`);
44033: 
44034:             if (!clicked) {
44035:                 const bruteClicked = await mfBruteClickFirstApproach(`auto-transport-police-brute-${reason}`);
44036: 
44037:                 if (!bruteClicked) {
44038:                     if (mfDebugEnabled) {
44039:                         debugLog('AUTO TRANSPORT', `${reason}: Approach found but click helper did not click yet; waiting for Vue/iframe update.`);
44040:                     }
44041: 
44042:                     await wait(1800);
44043:                     continue;
44044:                 }
44045:             }
44046: 
44047:             sentCount += 1;
44048: 
44049:             updateStatusBox(`Transport sent (${sentCount}). Checking for more transport requests...`);
44050:         }
44051: 
44052:         if (sentCount > 0) {
44053:             await wait(1200);
44054: 
44055:             const rehookWaitStarted = Date.now();
44056: 
44057:             while (
44058:                 isPostTransportRehookPending() &&
44059:                 !isManualAutoStopActive() &&
44060:                 Date.now() - rehookWaitStarted < 60000
44061:             ) {
44062:                 await wait(500);
44063:             }
44064:         }
44065: 
44066:         if (mfDebugEnabled) {
44067:             debugLog('AUTO TRANSPORT', `${reason}: completed. sent=${sentCount}`);
44068:         }
44069: 
44070:         return sentCount > 0 ? 'sent' : 'none';
44071:     }

44074:     async function waitForQueueRestartAndOpenMission(reason) {
44075:         // This function is entered only after the final mission's Dispatch
44076:         // click succeeded. MissionChief often leaves old red update alerts
44077:         // visible for a short time after Dispatch. Those stale alerts must
44078:         // not cancel the final close / unattended-count / reopen workflow.
44079:         if (mfQueueRestartWaiting) return false;
44080: 
44081:         mfQueueRestartWaiting = true;
44082: 
44083:         try {
44084:             sessionStorage.setItem(
44085:                 MF_QUEUE_WAIT_ACTIVE_FLAG,
44086:                 'true'
44087:             );
44088:             sessionStorage.removeItem(
44089:                 MF_QUEUE_OPENING_MISSION_FLAG
44090:             );
44091:             sessionStorage.removeItem(
44092:                 MF_FINAL_QUEUE_DISPATCH_FLAG
44093:             );
44094:             sessionStorage.setItem('mf_auto_mode_running', 'true');
44095:             autoModeRunning = true;
44096: 
44097:             updateStatusBox(`End of queue reached (${reason}). Closing mission and handing over to silent queue watcher...`);
44098: 
44099:             if (mfDebugEnabled) {
44100:                 debugLog('SILENT QUEUE', `handover started. reason=${reason}`);
44101:             }
44102: 
44103:             startSilentQueueWatcher();
44104: 
44105:             const closed = await closeMissionScreenForQueueRestart();
44106: 
44107:             if (mfDebugEnabled) {
44108:                 debugLog('SILENT QUEUE', `Close clicked=${closed ? 'yes' : 'no'} | missionVisible=${isMissionScreenVisibleForQueueRestart() ? 'yes' : 'no'}`);
44109:             }
44110: 
44111:             await wait(1000);
44112: 
44113:             updateStatusBox(
44114:                 `Silent queue watcher active. Waiting for ${getConfiguredQueueRestartThreshold()} unattended missions.`
44115:             );
44116:             return false;
44117:         } finally {
44118:             // Do not clear queue-wait here. The silent watcher owns the next open.
44119:             mfQueueRestartWaiting = false;
44120:         }
44121:     }

43580:     async function clickExactApproachTransportButton(reason) {
43581:         if (isManualAutoStopActive()) return false;
43582:         if (!isTransportAutomationAllowed()) return false;
43583:         if (mfGlobalTransportClicking) return false;
43584:         if (mfTransportApproachClicking) return false;

43610:                 debugLog('GLOBAL TRANSPORT', 'Blocked stale Approach button from a background transport modal.');
43611:             }

43617:         const now = Date.now();
43618: 
43619:         // Four seconds between Approach clicks.
43620:         if (fingerprint && fingerprint === mfLastTransportFingerprint && now - mfLastTransportClickAt < 4000) {
43621:             return false;
43622:         }
43623: 
43624:         mfGlobalTransportClicking = true;
43625:         mfTransportApproachClicking = true;
43626:         mfLastTransportFingerprint = fingerprint || '';
43627:         mfLastTransportClickAt = now;
43628:         mfTransportLastClickAt = now;
43629:         markTransportSequenceActive();
43630: 
43631:         try {
43632:             const row = button.closest('tr');
43633:             const rowText = row ? (row.innerText || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : '';
43634:             const text = (button.textContent || 'Approach').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
43635: 
43636:             if (mfDebugEnabled) {
43637:                 debugLog('GLOBAL TRANSPORT', `${reason}: clicking "${text}" | row="${rowText}"`);
43638:             }
43639:

43641:                 updateStatusBox(`Transport handoff: clicking ${text}...`);
43642:             } catch (error) {}
43643:

43651:             mfGlobalTransportClicking = false;
43652:             mfTransportApproachClicking = false;

45553:     async function runAutoModeLoop() {
45554:         if (isManualAutoStopActive()) return;

45567:             if (!isCurrentMissionExecutionOwner('Auto Mode cycle')) {

45570:                 );
45571:                 break;

45581:                         debugLog('QUEUE OPEN GUARD', 'Expired queue-opening flag cleared.');
45582:                     }
45583:                 } else {
45584:                     updateStatusBox('Queue restart is opening the next mission...');
45585:                     await wait(350);
45586:                     continue;
45587:                 }
45588:             }
45589: 
45590:             if (sessionStorage.getItem(MF_FINAL_QUEUE_DISPATCH_FLAG) === 'true') {
45591:                 const restarted = await waitForQueueRestartAndOpenMission('same-screen-after-final-dispatch');
45592: 
45593:                 if (restarted) {
45594:                     continue;
45595:                 }
45596: 
45597:                 break;
45598:             }
45599: 
45600:             if (!isMissionPage()) {
45601:                 updateStatusBox('Auto Mode waiting for next mission...');

45603:                 continue;
45604:             }

47401:     function dispatchMissionFinderFrameRuntimeEvent(
47402:         candidateDocument,
47403:         detail = {}
47404:     ) {
47405:         try {
47406:             if (!candidateDocument?.documentElement) return;
47407:

47409:                 candidateDocument.defaultView || window;
47410:             const EventConstructor =
47411:                 ownerWindow.CustomEvent || CustomEvent;
47412: 
47413:             candidateDocument.dispatchEvent(
47414:                 new EventConstructor(
47415:                     MF_FRAME_RUNTIME_RECONCILE_EVENT,
47416:                     { detail }
47417:                 )
47418:             );
47419:         } catch (_error) {}
47420:     }

47441:         records = []
47442:     ) {
47443:         if (!MF_IS_TOP_WINDOW) return;
47444: 
47445:         const frames = new Set();

47447:         const addFrames = node => {
47448:             if (!node || node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
47449:                 return;
47450:             }
47451: 
47452:             if (node.matches?.('iframe')) {
47453:                 frames.add(node);
47454:             }
47455: 
47456:             try {
47457:                 node.querySelectorAll?.('iframe')
47458:                     .forEach(frame => frames.add(frame));
47459:             } catch (_error) {}
47460:         };
47461: 
47462:         records.forEach(record => {
47463:             record.removedNodes?.forEach(addFrames);
47464:         });
47465: 
47466:         frames.forEach(frame => {
47467:             try {
47468:                 const candidateDocument =
47469:                     frame.contentDocument ||
47470:                     frame.contentWindow?.document;
47471: 
47472:                 dispatchMissionFinderFrameRuntimeEvent(
47473:                     candidateDocument,
47474:                     {
47475:                         removed: true,
47476:                         reason:
47477:                             'owner document removed mission iframe'
47478:                     }
47479:                 );
47480:             } catch (_error) {}
47481:         });

47401:     function dispatchMissionFinderFrameRuntimeEvent(
47402:         candidateDocument,
47403:         detail = {}
47404:     ) {
47405:         try {
47406:             if (!candidateDocument?.documentElement) return;
47407:

47409:                 candidateDocument.defaultView || window;
47410:             const EventConstructor =
47411:                 ownerWindow.CustomEvent || CustomEvent;
47412: 
47413:             candidateDocument.dispatchEvent(
47414:                 new EventConstructor(
47415:                     MF_FRAME_RUNTIME_RECONCILE_EVENT,
47416:                     { detail }
47417:                 )
47418:             );
47419:         } catch (_error) {}
47420:     }

47440:     function releaseRemovedMissionFinderFrameRuntimes(
47441:         records = []
47442:     ) {
47443:         if (!MF_IS_TOP_WINDOW) return;
47444: 
47445:         const frames = new Set();
47446: 
47447:         const addFrames = node => {
47448:             if (!node || node.nodeType !== Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
47449:                 return;
47450:             }
47451: 
47452:             if (node.matches?.('iframe')) {
47453:                 frames.add(node);
47454:             }
47455: 
47456:             try {
47457:                 node.querySelectorAll?.('iframe')
47458:                     .forEach(frame => frames.add(frame));
47459:             } catch (_error) {}
47460:         };
47461: 
47462:         records.forEach(record => {
47463:             record.removedNodes?.forEach(addFrames);
47464:         });
47465: 
47466:         frames.forEach(frame => {
47467:             try {
47468:                 const candidateDocument =
47469:                     frame.contentDocument ||
47470:                     frame.contentWindow?.document;
47471: 
47472:                 dispatchMissionFinderFrameRuntimeEvent(
47473:                     candidateDocument,
47474:                     {
47475:                         removed: true,
47476:                         reason:
47477:                             'owner document removed mission iframe'
47478:                     }
47479:                 );
47480:             } catch (_error) {}
47481:         });
47482:     }

47495:                     'top-window ownership check'

47497:         };
47498:

47500:             MF_FRAME_RUNTIME_RECONCILE_EVENT,

47502:         );
47503:     }

===== getLiveMissionTrainedPersonnelRequirementsForDisplay (window lines 27550-27770) =====
27550:     function getLiveMissionTrainedPersonnelRequirementsForDisplay() {
27551:         if (
27552:             !hasMissionVehiclesOnSceneForTrainedPersonnelAuthority()
27553:         ) {
27554:             return [];
27555:         }
27556: 
27557:         let liveRows = [];
27558: 
27559:         try {
27560:             liveRows = normaliseOperationalRequirementRows(
27561:                 readMissionUpdateRows({ silent: true })
27562:             );
27563:         } catch (error) {
27564:             if (mfDebugEnabled) {
27565:                 debugLog(
27566:                     'LIVE TRAINED PERSONNEL DISPLAY',
27567:                     `current shortage read failed: ${error?.message || error}`
27568:                 );
27569:             }
27570: 
27571:             return [];
27572:         }
27573: 
27574:         const requirements = new Map();
27575: 
27576:         liveRows
27577:             .filter(row => {
27578:                 return (
27579:                     row?.isTrainedPersonnelRequirement === true &&
27580:                     Array.isArray(row?.personnelTrainingRequirements)
27581:                 );
27582:             })
27583:             .forEach(row => {
27584:                 row.personnelTrainingRequirements
27585:                     .forEach(requirement => {
27586:                         const requiredTrainingCodes =
27587:                             Array.isArray(requirement?.requiredTrainingCodes)
27588:                                 ? requirement.requiredTrainingCodes
27589:                                     .map(value => String(value || '').trim())
27590:                                     .filter(Boolean)
27591:                                 : [];
27592:                         const code =
27593:                             requiredTrainingCodes[0] ||
27594:                             String(requirement?.code || '')
27595:                                 .replace(/_vehicle$/i, '')
27596:                                 .trim();
27597:                         const missing = Math.max(
27598:                             0,
27599:                             parseInt(
27600:                                 requirement?.personnelRequired ??
27601:                                 requirement?.required,
27602:                                 10
27603:                             ) || 0
27604:                         );
27605: 
27606:                         if (!code || missing <= 0) return;
27607: 
27608:                         const existing =
27609:                             requirements.get(code);
27610: 
27611:                         if (
27612:                             !existing ||
27613:                             missing > existing.missing
27614:                         ) {
27615:                             requirements.set(code, {
27616:                                 code,
27617:                                 label:
27618:                                     getSelectedTrainingDisplayLabel(code),
27619:                                 missing
27620:                             });
27621:                         }
27622:                     });
27623:             });
27624: 
27625:         return Array.from(requirements.values())
27626:             .sort((left, right) => {
27627:                 return left.label.localeCompare(right.label);
27628:             });
27629:     }

22923: 
22924:         const percent = totalRequired > 0 ? Math.round((foundRequired / totalRequired) * 100) : vehicleLoadState.ready ? 100 : 0;
22925:         const preloadedCoverageComplete = Boolean(
22926:             usingPreloadedRows &&
22927:             totalRequired > 0 &&
22928:             foundRequired >= totalRequired

22963: 
22964:                 if (selected >= required && required > 0) {

22966:                     cls = 'mf2026-good';
22967:                 } else if (row.status === 'missing') {
22968:                     icon = '✕';
22969:                     cls = 'mf2026-bad';
22970:                 } else if (selected > 0 || row.status === 'retrying') {

17091:                         );
